payload.summary: The accounts for 2023/24, the widest year of the five: a General Fund underspend of £4.050m, 6.23% of gross expenditure. The council names the reasons — £2.8m of a budgeted reserve drawdown that turned out not to be needed, £1.950m from a change to how it calculates debt repayment, and £1.458m of interest on its day-to-day cash. Capital spending was £40.588m against £55.829m.
